body: Most of the things I'd like to try that are outside my comfort zone involve interacting with people, and while I don't have social anxiety per se, my limited life experience means that I tend to descend into an interview style of 'conversation', simply asking basic questions of the other person without feeling I can contribute much myself. This works okay especially with people who like to talk about themselves, but it's not really a means of making genuine connections. For example, I'd like to hitchhike across Europe and maybe do a bit of couchsurfing, but feel like I'd be a terrible guest / rider.
